questions.text: Have you noticed anything feeling repetitive or cyclical in your recent days? What would you change to break the cycle?

Are we at a point in our adventure where it feels like a never ending saga and we should put this part of our story to rest because it's becoming cliché? Has there been some very frequent ocurring event its getting old?
Has there been time for the normal and mundane? Have I had a chance to just do normal stuff? Health, necessities, grooming, cooking, resting etc?

Honestly, from the party who of us is the most cliché one and why do I think that? Have they been talking like textbook psychological cliché like talking about walls? What do I think would make them less cliché? I'm not talking about comedic manneirisms, those are perfect as they are. What I'm more worried is psychological / therapy-like clichés.
Is there something you were in the middle of doing that got interrupted? Do you want to go back to it, or has it lost its meaning?
Has there happened something that doesn't make much sense knowing my own world? Have I met someone who acted differently from what I remember?
Is there someone you feel a growing tension with — positive or negative — that you haven't fully addressed yet?
Was there a choice you made recently that sits poorly with you? Or one you saw someone else make that you disagree with?
What is the thing you are most afraid of happening in the next few hours?
If you could skip ahead to any outcome right now, what would you want to find yourself doing?
What is something you did recently that you are secretly proud of, even if no one else noticed?
How is your body holding up? Is there a physical ache or a sense of exhaustion you're trying to ignore?
Do you feel like the same person you were when this journey started? What part of you feels different?
Is there someone you've started to care about more than you're willing to admit?
Which of your habits is making this situation harder than it needs to be?
Are you worried about running out of something? Time, energy, supplies, or luck?
